name: TED
body: HSTS is on, every image analyzed has alt text, talks carry author and date, and Consent Mode starts denied. But the viewport sets maximum-scale=1.0 and user-scalable=no, which blocks pinch zoom on phones.
lesson: Drop maximum-scale and user-scalable=no from the viewport, so people with low vision can enlarge text.
summary: www.ted.com scores 75 out of 100 (C). 4 checks fail now, 18 are at risk, and 21 pass. Fix first: 24 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 24 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /talks, /playlists, /series and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 1 AI answer or search crawler is blocked
fix.evidence: Amazonbot (Alexa answers) by Disallow: /. These bots fetch pages to cite them in answers. Blocked means the site is not quoted there.
fix.fix: Allow the answer bots in robots.txt. Training bots can stay blocked if that is the policy.

fix.title: Security headers on the start page are missing on other pages
fix.evidence: frame protection on 15 pages, X-Content-Type-Options on 15 pages, Referrer-Policy on 15 pages, out of 20 pages read. Attackers pick the weakest page.
fix.fix: Set the headers once at the server, CDN, or host config so every response carries them.

fix.title: The viewport stops people from zooming
fix.evidence: The viewport tag sets user-scalable=no or maximum-scale=1.
fix.fix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport tag.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages read.

fix.title: 5 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /topics, /newsletters, /games, /tedx/events and 1 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
Model-training crawlers are blocked by choice
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
Share cards have a title, description, image, and URL
